title: a member posts a Proposal; others say they're in or offer to help

criteria.text: A Wonder is a post kind on a Page the member manages: words, a threshold (a whole number), and an optional list of sizes or options the poster names
criteria.note: A Proposal (internally `wonder`) is a post kind on a Page the member manages: words, an optional whole-number goal, optional sizes; Create's + menu has 'Propose something' (#1094, plan #218).
